stage1.impression: A competent, well-composed hospitality visualisation with true verticals, a believable 28 mm eye-level view and warm pools of light, but it reads as CG. The floor looks like pale marble lit by a hard daylight-like raking source, the rainbow ring globe reads as a neon gyroscope or nightclub fixture rather than thick cast acrylic, and the speakers at the far end are small white boxes rather than the hero. The stools, chairs, Orbs and tables repeat as identical copies. A magazine would see a generic upscale bar with a showpiece light, not a specific place.

blocking_9: Floor reads as dark concrete at night: no bright raking band. Foreground floor [200,600,500,800] lum_median 35-65 instead of 106, and it should get darker toward the camera, not brighter.
Mother EARF reads as thick polished cast acrylic, with disc faces faintly visible and rims glowing as edge light, not as thin neon tubes.
The altar pair reads at a glance as smoked tinted acrylic cabinets under a pool of light, not as white boxes: altar speaker regions lum_median >= 45 with p95 < 215.
The coloured shadow on the wall stops being the brightest large surface in the frame (median 142 now), so the eye goes to the globe and then the altar.
Fir beams and timber read as warm brown, not pink-orange: top band r_median <= 62.
Signs of life and variation: the tables dressed differently, and the repeated identical Orbs, chairs and stools broken up by props and occupancy cues.
Concrete shows tie holes, pour lines and board grain at 1:1 on the right wall; at the moment it reads as flat plaster.

defects.what: Floor reads as pale polished marble or terrazzo under a hard, uncoloured raking source that casts crisp stool shadows toward the camera; it brightens toward the frame bottom (profile 28 to 166). That is daylight logic in a night room.
Mother EARF rims read as thin saturated neon tubes; the 25 mm disc bodies and their polished edges are invisible, so it reads as a nightclub or signage light, not premium acrylic.
Altar Atmosphere pair reads as white boxes with a white woofer, with no smoked tint visible; tiny in the frame, with hot tops (p95 216-231) and dark surrounds (median 28-34).
Visible haze cones above the altar speakers read as stage beams.
Projected coloured shadow is the brightest large area (median 142), pulling the eye to the far right edge; the concrete under it reads as smooth plaster without board grain or tie holes.
Ceiling beams are oversaturated orange-red (r 74 / g 40 / b 24); the fir reads as pink varnish.
Zinc counter top reads as a near-white flat slab (median 151, p95 239) with no patina or zinc mottling.
Identical stool and chair models repeated in rows with identical spacing; obvious repeated-asset look.
Four identical Orb lamps on identical tables in a perfect diagonal; the tables have almost no props (one glass), so there is no sign of life on the banquette side.
Large framed screen at the right edge is a flat lilac-grey rectangle with a blue smudge and reads as an unfinished texture.
A uniform fine grain over a soft denoised base; surfaces look smooth CG under the grain.

changes.problem: A hard, uncoloured source rakes the near floor and makes it the brightest large area in the lower frame, so it reads as daylight on marble, not a night room.

evidence.measured: lum_median 105.9, p95 194.6; y-profile rises 28 -> 166 toward the camera; crisp stool shadows running toward camera-left, so the source is behind and to the right of the stools and high (consistent with a lamp near the globe or the Domes' downlights)

change.setting: the hard source lighting the floor between x 4 and 6 m (check the Domes' downlights 4 x spot and the Mother EARF hard spot's spill); floor finish
change.from: Domes' downlights 32.0 W, cone 20 deg; floor pale with a high polish
change.to: Domes' downlights 14 W, cone 14 deg, kept on the counter top only; make sure no lamp other than the globe spot reaches the floor in the foreground; floor finish darker honed concrete (albedo about 0.18, roughness 0.55)

changes.expected: Foreground floor drops into a low-key warm grey, darker toward the camera, with only soft pools under the tables; the eye goes up into the room.

changes.problem: Mother EARF's rims glow like neon tube and the cast acrylic bodies vanish, so the centrepiece reads as a nightclub fixture, not premium acrylic.

evidence.measured: rims are thin saturated lines with clip_pct 0.19; disc faces read as near-invisible film; region median 32.5 against p95 201

change.setting: Mother EARF rim glow, and the hard spot
change.from: rim glow 0.14; hard spot 140.0 W, cone 30.0 deg
change.to: rim glow 0.06; hard spot 110 W, cone 24 deg, so the spot's light through the discs carries their colour and their faces pick up a soft caustic tint

changes.expected: Rims read as polished edges of thick acrylic catching and piping light, the disc faces faintly tinted and visible, and no clipping on the rims.

changes.problem: The altar pair, the room's reason to exist, reads as two small white boxes with hot tops in a dark niche; no smoked tint is visible.

evidence.measured: lum_median 34.2, p95 230.8; the second speaker [650,360,700,430] median 28.1, p95 216.6; visible haze cones above at [500,300,700,360]

change.setting: the altar's spots, and the haze
change.from: 2 x spot, 170.0 W, 2500 K, cone 30.0 deg; haze 0.003
change.to: 2 x spot, 95 W, 2500 K, cone 40 deg, aimed at the cabinet's mid-height so the light passes through the smoked acrylic, not onto the white batts at the top; add a low 2700 K wash on the altar's back wall (about 10 W area) so the silhouettes separate; haze 0.0015

changes.expected: Both speakers read as smoked translucent cabinets with a glowing interior, at even brightness top to bottom, framed by a dim warm wall, with no beams.

changes.problem: The globe's coloured shadow on the right wall is the brightest large surface in the frame and pulls the eye to the edge.

evidence.measured: lum_median 142.2, higher than any other large region; the speakers are at 28-34

change.to: 110 W, and the concrete wall's albedo down about 15 % (concrete tone)

changes.expected: The coloured shadow stays legible as the centrepiece's signature but sits below the globe and the bar in the hierarchy.

changes.problem: The grade pushes the fir and walnut to a saturated pink-orange, so the timber reads as varnish and the warmth looks graded, not lit.

change.from: white_balance_k 3000, look AgX - Medium High Contrast
change.to: white_balance_k 2750, look AgX - Base Contrast, with saturation -10 % in the grade

changes.expected: Timber reads as warm brown fir with visible grain; the concrete turns warm grey instead of peach; the globe's tints stand out more because the room is more neutral.

changes.problem: The zinc counter top reads as a near-white flat slab, the second-brightest surface in the frame, with no metal character.

change.to: aged blue-grey zinc: base albedo about 0.35, metallic, roughness 0.35 varied by a large-scale mottling and ring-mark map +/-0.1

changes.expected: The counter reads as a metal top with soft broken reflections of the pendants, about a stop darker.

changes.problem: The banquette tables are identical and almost empty, so the room reads as a showroom with repeated assets.

evidence.measured: four identical Orb plus table units in a perfect diagonal; one rocks glass in total on them; no coat, menu or sleeve on the banquette

change.from: 3 rocks, 2 coupes, 5 napkins, 2 votives, 1 matchbook, 1 coat (mostly on the counter and in the zone)
change.to: on the banquette: a coupe and a rocks glass at different fill levels on the nearest table, a folded menu and a record sleeve on the second, a coat and a scarf on the banquette seat, one chair pulled out and turned about 15 deg, two stools at the counter turned

changes.expected: The right half reads as lived-in and the repetition breaks up; there is a sign of life in the foreground.

changes.problem: The board-formed concrete reads as smooth plaster at 1:1, with no tie holes, pour lines or board grain.

evidence.measured: crop at 2x shows a uniform fine speckle; no board seams, tie holes or staining under the projected light where they would show most

change.to: board-formed: 100-150 mm horizontal board grain in the normal and roughness maps, tie holes on a 600 x 900 mm grid, faint pour-line staining, roughness 0.7-0.85, warm grey

changes.expected: Under the coloured shadow and the grazing light along the banquette, the wall shows real board texture and reads as Ando-like concrete.

out_of_scope.request: Make the speakers larger in the frame or move the camera closer to the altar so they are the hero.
out_of_scope.why: This frame is fixed as the whole room from the door, with Mother EARF as the centrepiece; the speakers' size and placement are the room's design.

out_of_scope.request: Reduce Mother EARF to one or two tints, or make it smaller, so the room keeps one colour.
out_of_scope.why: The owner chose the six tints and the 1.25 m size; they are fixed product and design decisions. The globe's multicolour breaks the one-colour reference by intent.

out_of_scope.request: Vary the stool, chair and table models to break the repeated-asset look.
out_of_scope.why: The seats and furniture are fixed room design; only props and placement cues can vary them (c7).

out_of_scope.request: Replace the flat lilac image on the large right-hand screen with something that reads as real content.
out_of_scope.why: The card fixes the screens and what they show; only their brightness may change.
